plays.summary: After white attacks down our right flank, our goalkeeper rushes out to smother the dangerous low cross in the box and clear the danger.

players.note: Step up earlier to close down the winger and deny the angle for the pass into the box instead of dropping off too deep.
Decisive sweeper-keeper intervention off the line, reading the danger early and clearing cleanly just like Manuel Neuer.

plays.summary: Our defender blocks the opponent's free kick on the far side and launches a long forward pass for our left winger to chase down the touchline.

players.note: Sharp anticipation to cut out the set piece and immediately turn defense into attack, reminiscent of Andrew Robertson.
Look to take a positive first touch inside toward goal so the defender cannot trap you against the touchline.

plays.summary: Our striker presses the white defenders aggressively on the right side, forcing them to retreat and play all the way back to their goalkeeper.

players.note: Relentless high pressing and angling of the run to cut off forward options, just like Roberto Firmino leading the press from the front.

plays.summary: Our team wins the ball high up the pitch off the opponent's build-up and creates a quick chance in the box that loops just over the crossbar.

players.note: Intelligent high-press turnover to win possession in the final third and release quickly, similar to Sadio Mane.
Quick vertical vision to slip the runner into space before the defense recovers, much like Kevin De Bruyne.
Great movement to get on the end of the through ball; try to keep your chest over the finish next time to keep the shot under the bar.

plays.summary: After restarting from a midfield free kick, our midfielders combine smoothly before feeding the left winger, who drives into the box and forces a corner.

players.note: Composed short passing under pressure to retain possession and switch the tempo, like Toni Kroos.
Well-timed pass into the wide channel to isolate the full-back, reminiscent of David Silva.
Direct 1v1 running at pace to beat the defender and get a shot away, just like Vinicius Junior.

plays.summary: Our corner kick is whipped dangerously into the six-yard box, where an attacker meets it with a close-range effort that forces a goalmouth clearance.

players.note: Accurate, driven delivery right into the danger area of the six-yard box, similar to Trent Alexander-Arnold.
Attack the ball decisively in the air, and aim downward toward the corners to give the goalkeeper no chance to parry.

plays.summary: Our midfield threads a clever through ball into the left channel for our striker, who drives into the box and fires a low shot saved by the goalkeeper.

players.note: Incisive line-breaking through ball weighted perfectly into the runner's stride, just like Luka Modric.
Explosive forward run and composed strike across goal under defensive pressure, reminiscent of Karim Benzema.

plays.summary: Another dangerous corner kick into the six-yard box leads to a close-range scramble and shot attempt before the white goalkeeper smothers the ball.

players.note: Consistent, threatening corner delivery putting the goalkeeper under immediate pressure, like Kieran Trippier.
Good instincts to attack the second ball in the scramble; try to get a cleaner first-time toe-poke or lift it over the diving keeper.

plays.summary: Our midfielder reads white's forward pass out of the back and steps in front to make a clean interception in midfield.

players.note: Sharp anticipation to read the pass and step ahead of the attacker cleanly, just like N'Golo Kante.
